audit.whatIsWrong: The page repeatedly described Going Rogue (W) as a heal/sustain off minions — spikes[0].text ('W heal-off-minions'), early ('passive healing off minion damage'), wants.you[0] ('his W punishes you for walking up'), wants.foe[0] ('Poke with autos and W sustain'). Going Rogue is a camouflage/Scoundrel-resurrection ability with no healing whatsoever. late also claimed a 'stealth-reset ... after takedowns'.
audit.why: Riot text on W: marks Scoundrels, resurrects allies on killing one, and on activation grants camouflage, Move Speed and Mana Regen while moving toward Scoundrels. The only lane sustain in the kit is Dirty Fighting (P), which is a SHIELD every three hits on a champion.
audit.corrected: Replaced every sustain claim with the real one: Dirty Fighting shields him every three landed hits, and it needs those three hits to exist at all — so deny them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page said Heroic Swing requires terrain, yet three fields called it a dash/escape that keeps him out of stun range.
audit.why: Riot text: 'Akshan fires a grappling hook into terrain then swings around it.' Away from a wall it does not fire, which is exactly the situation in the middle of mid lane.
audit.corrected: Heroic Swing now stated as terrain-anchored, 18s at rank 1, and the whole commit rule is 'fight where there is no wall'.

audit.whatIsWrong: full phases[3].side, phases[5].side and phases[6].side read 'Skill' while content win[3], win[5], win[6] and packet.levelChart all read 'Annie'.
audit.why: Three rows rendered two different answers. 55.38% at 1125 games supports the Annie-favoured content version.
audit.corrected: Flipped the three full sides to Annie as one group, with ratings 6/7/7 and whys rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose named no Akshan ability (packet defect) and framed him as a mobile sustain poker.
audit.why: The real shape is a 850-range Avengerang against your 625, a shield that needs three hits, and an escape that needs a wall.
audit.corrected: Restated across tldr, enemyWin, early, mid and breakdown.difficulty-adjacent fields.

audit.whatIsWrong: report[8].t said 'Add anti-heal early into his sustain.'
audit.why: Akshan has no heal in his kit — Dirty Fighting grants a shield. Grievous Wounds does nothing here, so this line spends 800 gold for zero effect.
audit.corrected: Replaced with an explicit 'his Dirty Fighting is a shield, so skip anti-heal'.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2].d called Heroic Swing a 'fifteen-second' cooldown; breakdown.cooldowns carried no numbers.
audit.why: Heroic Swing is 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s — 18s at rank 1. Avengerang is 9s at rank 1, Comeuppance 100s.
audit.corrected: Numbers now stated; the Comeuppance bullet also records that the first minion hit absorbs every bullet.

notes: Biggest find on this matchup: four separate fields described Going Rogue (W) as minion-based healing/sustain. It is a camouflage plus Scoundrel-resurrection ability with no heal in it; the only buffer in Akshan's kit is the Dirty Fighting (P) shield every three hits. report[8].t was telling the player to buy Grievous Wounds 'into his sustain' — 800 gold for literally zero effect. Second find: Heroic Swing was called a dash/escape in three fields with no mention that it must anchor into terrain, which is the single most actionable fact in the matchup (mid lane's centre has no wall). Also corrected late's 'stealth-on-takedown' — camouflage is on W activation toward Scoundrels, and it is the RESURRECTION that keys off killing one. Level chart: full phases[3/5/6].side were 'Skill' against content win[] and packet both saying Annie; proposed the three flips as one group. breakdown.wave and dontsFull[1].d left templated — nothing Akshan-specific fit inside the band without inventing.
